title: Sungas and Kanvas: more sources, founders, succession

boxes.title: Sources: added detail
items: Gargi Samhita = **Yuga Purana**; Yavanas reached Saketa, **Panchala**, **Mathura**
Mahabhashya: "we perform sacrifices for Pushyamitra"; comments on **Ashtadhyayi** via Katyayana's **Varttikas**; 2nd-c.-BCE society, geography
**Manusmriti** took early shape now; foreigners = "Vratya Kshatriyas"
Malavikagnimitram: ==Kalidasa's **first play**==; Agnimitra-**Malavika** love story; war with Vidarbha

boxes.title: Dynasty & rule: added
items: Brihadratha killed **185 BCE** in some notes; Sunga dates ⚠ UPSC **187-78 BC**
Sunga ancestors from ==**Ujjain**==; Kanvas also Brahmins
Beat Bactrian Greek **Demetrius**, who challenged his sacrificial horse
==**Patanjali**== supervised the two Ashvamedhas; royal priest
Sunga court revived ==**classical Sanskrit**== (Ashoka used Prakrit)

boxes.title: Persecution, art, AP angle
items: Taranatha: destroyed stupas, ==bounty on monks' heads==
Merchants, guilds kept funding Buddhism; hostility aimed at monasteries allied with Indo-Greeks
Sanchi: stone railings (**vedika**); south torana linked to ==**Satakarni II**== (Ananda's inscription)
Bharhut: early narrative art; **stone carvers**' guilds paid; **Bodh Gaya**: early stone railing
Heliodorus: absorption of foreigners into Indian religion
**Ashtamahasthana** (8 Buddhist sites) listed (**2026**); **Satakarni I** said to have beaten Pushyamitra
